title: Exotic Earthy Egyptian Ricotta Tagine
description: A citrusy and shaggy Egyptian dish featuring ricotta, miso-marinate, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, cooked in a cataplana vessel, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together miso paste, lemon juice, and olive oil to make the marinade.
In a separate bowl, mix together ricotta cheese, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the marinade to the ricotta mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a cataplana vessel or a large oven-safe skillet.
Cover the vessel with a lid or aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs or citrus wedges if desired.
